scope: New specialist creative, scientific, productivity and accessibility software. Product documentation was reviewed; no installation or benchmarking was performed.
method: Official product sites, publisher-linked repositories, raw upstream READMEs and license files, download documentation and release Atom feeds were retrieved. The SHA-256 is of the retrieved response bytes. Source claim lists identify which observed fields the page supports. Editorial fit judgments are identified separately. Failed candidates and unsupported claims were excluded or kept unknown.
maintenance_method: An explicit dated upstream announcement or a release-feed entry updated within the preceding year supports active status. Atom updated timestamps are not represented as release publication dates. Missing evidence produces unverified status, not a claim of abandonment.
known_review_gaps: No software was installed, executed, benchmarked or checked against a specific device during this review.
Download URLs are verified official landing pages or repository release pages, not version-pinned executable links.
Unknown pricing or licensing means the evidence was insufficient for that metadata field; it does not imply that a product charges money.
Research, simulation and imaging workflows need validation appropriate to their own inputs and purposes.
No popularity counts were converted into quality rankings.

exclusions.reason: Official website says the project will return; repository describes a highly unstable alpha. Excluded from this curated addition pending a clearer usable release path.

corrections.reason: Current project homepage and downloads are at astroimagej.com; recorded that actual destination.
Stanford official source redirects to the Natural Capital Alliance site; retained the current official destination.
Primary website returned a transient 503; used the official repository and release page, documenting the website limitation.
The nominal homepage did not expose the expected software content during retrieval; the developer repository was used as the official identity and download route.
Publisher distinguishes GPL source, free binaries limited to SIL Open Font License output, and commercial binary editions; a blanket free/open-source binary claim was rejected.
Current upstream license identifies MIT core and directories with source-available/proprietary terms. Classified mixed rather than applying the old blanket license to every edition.
Current terms explicitly permit business use at no cost until business-license conditions are established; recorded free pricing with the qualification.
MIT source and custom binary terms differ; publisher states the binary license no longer restricts commercial use.
The named Zrythm license is AGPL-3.0-or-later with trademark conditions. Free limited, paid complete and alpha-testing installers differ.
Official download page links tedfelix/rosegarden-official as the upstream alternate repository; used its license rather than an unrelated unofficial mirror.
Used current GNOME source-tarball directory and the Evolution Team Flathub listing; the former apps.gnome.org path did not resolve.
